WELCOME TO CALDAS DA RAINHA
We  combine  Portuguese  hospitality  with  professional  investor  support,  a  clear  
process, target response times and a dedicated contact. From your first email to your 
site visit, you always know who is looking after your project and what happens next.

THE PATH, DAY BY DAY
WHEN WHAT HAPPENS WHAT YOU GET
D0–D1 Welcome Acknowledgement and named contact
D2–D4 Scope Project, needs and timeline
D5–D9 Connect Planning, sites, talent and funding
D10–D14 Plan Action plan or site visit
A FACE, NOT A COUNTER
Your project manager connects municipal services, external bodies and property owners, and stays with  
your project until the final decision — whether that is to settle here or go another way. If something gets stuck, 
there is a defined escalation path up to the municipal executive, within its powers.
Confidential enquiries are treated as such: tell us in your first message and we will agree with you how to 
share sensitive information.
